outcome: Bayley Scale of Infant and Toddler Development (Bayley) Edition III scores
cohort: The study included 55 preterm infants from whom a single blood sample was collected during their Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) stay.
finding: Increased mtDNAcn in white infants and decreased mtDNAcn in black infants were identified as significant predictors of poor early-life neurodevelopmental outcomes.
followup_time: Up to 2 years of corrected age
gest_age: Preterm infants, with increased mtDNAcn associated with younger birth gestational age (<30.57 wk), and neurobehavioral assessment at 36-38 postmenstrual age (PMA).
